approval: User approved source review and proposed performance evaluation.

rules.title: Evidence-bound source review before publication
rules.statement: New sync requires current source review. Preserve author text, bind review to source and provenance, invalidate changed approval, and distinguish evaluation calibration from model results.
evidence: User authorized source review gate and maintenance evaluation
limitations: Semantic review remains a host/user judgment; model executor availability is external

reviews.description: Review source approval and mutation paths plus evaluation validity

issues.title: Source review and maintenance evaluation
issues.contract: Implement review gating and run the evaluation as far as the available controlled environment supports, recording unexecuted model outcomes explicitly.
acceptance: Unreviewed or stale sources cannot publish
Review citations and provenance bound to current source
Legacy sources are not falsely auto-approved
Evaluation reports actual completions/failures/null usage separately from calibration
